column1: # T-GATES-047 timing-bound test list: every #[test] function whose own body waits on the real clock

# bt-source's timing test holds the tree to this list both ways; scripts/ci/check-timing-bound.ps1 lets whole
# rows only disappear against the merge base. A clock reached only through a function the test calls is not
# seen by the scan; review owns finding it.
